mapper.sql: SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT '' AS ROWFLAG, ROWNUM AS RNUM, COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_RECORDS, DATA.* FROM (
mapper.select: SELECT IMPDEC_NO ,ACPT_DATE ,LQTX_AMOUNT ,ECX_AMOUNT ,SUM(CSTMS) AS CSTMS ,SUM(QY) AS QY ,SUM(REMNDR_QY) AS REMNDR_QY ,SUM(CVODV_KRW) AS CVODV_KRW ,SUM(CVODV_USD) AS CVODV_USD ,TOT_TAXAMT ,SUM(REMNDR_TAX) AS REMNDR_TAX ,MAX(USE_YN) AS USE_YN ,MAX(LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD) AS LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD ,MAX(LC_NO) AS LC_NO ,MASTER_BL_NO ,INCME_DELNG_SE ,INCME_TYPE ,XPORT_NATION_CODE FROM (SELECT A.IMPDEC_NO ,A.ACPT_DATE ,B.LNE_NO ,B.POUCH_NO ,B.QY ,A.LQTX_AMOUNT ,A.ECX_AMOUNT ,NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, B.QY) AS REMNDR_QY ,NVL(A.CVODV_KRW, 0) AS CVODV_KRW ,NVL(A.CVODV_USD, 0) AS CVODV_USD ,A.TOT_TAXAMT ,NVL(B.CSTMS, 0) AS CSTMS ,NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, B.QY) * (NVL(B.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(B.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(B.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(B.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(B.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(B.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0)) AS REMNDR_TAX ,CASE WHEN C.REMNDR_QY IS NULL THEN '미사용' WHEN C.REMNDR_QY = 0 THEN '모두사용' ELSE '일부' END AS USE_YN ,C.LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD ,A.LC_NO ,A.MASTER_BL_NO ,A.INCME_DELNG_SE ,A.INCME_TYPE ,A.XPORT_NATION_CODE FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_HDER A INNER JOIN IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_NO = B.IMPDEC_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM C ON A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = C.DIVISION_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_NO = C.IMPDEC_NO AND B.LNE_NO = C.LNE_NO AND B.POUCH_NO = C.POUCH_NO AND B.ITEM_CODE = C.ITEM_CODE AND B.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND B.DIVISION_CODE = C.DIVISION_CODE WHERE A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}) GROUP BY IMPDEC_NO ,ACPT_DATE ,LQTX_AMOUNT ,ECX_AMOUNT ,TOT_TAXAMT ,MASTER_BL_NO ,INCME_DELNG_SE ,INCME_TYPE ,XPORT_NATION_CODE

SELECT IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO ,IMPDEC_NO ,LNE_NO ,HS_CODE ,LMTT_REGLTN ,SUM(CVODV_KRW) AS CVODV_KRW ,SUM(QY) AS QY ,SUM(DLIVY_QY) AS DLIVY_QY ,SUM(TOT_TAX) AS TOT_TAX ,MAX(LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD) AS LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD ,SUM(REMNDR_QY) AS REMNDR_QY ,SUM(USE_TAX) AS USE_TAX ,SUM(REMNDR_TAX) AS REMNDR_TAX FROM (SELECT A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO ,A.IMPDEC_NO ,A.LNE_NO ,A.HS_CODE ,CASE WHEN B.EFECT_BGNDE IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CASE WHEN A.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN B.EFECT_BGNDE AND B.EFECT_ENDDE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END AS LMTT_REGLTN ,NVL(A.CVODV_KRW, 0) AS CVODV_KRW ,NVL(A.QY, 0) AS QY ,CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = C.BASS_UNIT THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) ELSE (CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 1000 / 30 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 0.064799 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 1000 / 1000 ELSE NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) END) END AS DLIVY_QY
,NVL(A.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(A.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(A.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(A.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(A.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0) AS TOT_TAX ,C.LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD ,CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = C.BASS_UNIT THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) ELSE (CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 1000 / 30 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 0.064799 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 1000 / 1000 ELSE NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) END) END AS REMNDR_QY ,FLOOR((NVL(A.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(A.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(A.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(A.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(A.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0)) / A.QY * NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0)) AS USE_TAX ,FLOOR((NVL(A.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(A.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(A.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(A.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(A.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0)) / A.QY * NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, A.QY)) AS REMNDR_TAX FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM A LEFT OUTER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM C ON A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = C.DIVISION_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_NO = C.IMPDEC_NO AND A.LNE_NO = C.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = C.POUCH_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = C.ITEM_CODE AND A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = C.DIVISION_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.HS_CODE = B.HS_CODE AND B.DRWBAK_LMTT_REGLTN = '1' -- 단축고시정보 WHERE A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}) GROUP BY IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO ,IMPDEC_NO ,LNE_NO ,HS_CODE ,LMTT_REGLTN

SELECT A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO ,A.IMPDEC_NO ,A.LNE_NO ,A.POUCH_NO ,A.ITEM_CODE ,A.ITEM_NM ,FLOOR(NVL(A.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(A.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(A.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(A.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(A.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOT_TAX ,FLOOR((NVL(A.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(A.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(A.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(A.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(A.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0)) / A.QY * NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0)) AS USE_TAX ,FLOOR((NVL(A.CSTMS, 0) + NVL(A.INTTAX, 0) + NVL(A.ECX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(A.AGSPT, 0) + NVL(A.TRANTAX, 0) + NVL(A.LQTX_AMOUNT, 0)) / A.QY * NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, A.QY)) AS REMNDR_TAX ,A.QY ,A.BASS_UNIT ,CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = C.BASS_UNIT THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) ELSE (CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 1000 / 30 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 0.064799 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) / 1000 / 1000 ELSE NVL(C.REMNDR_QY, 0) END) END AS REMNDR_QY ,CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = C.BASS_UNIT THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) ELSE (CASE WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 0.453592 / 1000 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 1000 / 30 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 0.064799 WHEN A.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) / 1000 / 1000 ELSE NVL(C.DLIVY_QY, 0) END) END AS DLIVY_QY ,A.CVODV_KRW ,A.CVODV_USD FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM A LEFT OUTER JOIN INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM C ON A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = C.DIVISION_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_NO = C.IMPDEC_NO AND A.LNE_NO = C.LNE_NO AND A.POUCH_NO = C.POUCH_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = C.ITEM_CODE AND A.COMPANY_CODE = C.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = C.DIVISION_CODE WHERE A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.LNE_NO = #{LNE_NO}

SELECT T.COMPANY_CODE ,T.DIVISION_CODE ,T.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO ,T.MANUFAC_NAME ,T.EXPORTER_NAME ,T.ONBOARD_DATE ,T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,T.XPORT_SE ,T.DSPTH_DATE ,MAX(T.ITEM_CODE) AS ITEM_CODE ,MAX(T.ITEM_NM) AS ITEM_NM ,T.FRMLC_REPR ,SUM(T.STTEMNT_PC_KRW) AS STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,SUM(T.STTEMNT_PC_FGCRY) AS STTEMNT_PC_FGCRY ,SUM(T.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY ,T.CRNCY ,T.NATION_CODE ,T.DELY_CND ,T.EHGT ,T.HS_CODE ,T.SLE_UNIT ,T.ACPLC_CRNCY ,T.INV_NO ,T.XPORT_TYPE FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T.HS_CODE IS NOT NULL
AND T.DSPTH_DATE >= REPLACE(#{CAL_SEARCH_FROM_DATE}, '-', '')
AND T.DSPTH_DATE <= REPLACE(#{CAL_SEARCH_TO_DATE}, '-', '')
AND T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_NM = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.ITEM_NM LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_NM LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
GROUP BY T.COMPANY_CODE ,T.DIVISION_CODE ,T.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO ,T.MANUFAC_NAME ,T.EXPORTER_NAME ,T.ONBOARD_DATE ,T.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,T.XPORT_SE ,T.DSPTH_DATE ,T.FRMLC_REPR ,T.CRNCY ,T.NATION_CODE ,T.DELY_CND ,T.EHGT ,T.HS_CODE ,T.SLE_UNIT ,T.ACPLC_CRNCY ,T.INV_NO ,T.XPORT_TYPE

SELECT T.COMPANY_CODE ,T.DIVISION_CODE ,T.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO ,T.LNE_NO ,T.POUCH_NO ,T.HS_CODE ,T.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,T.ITEM_QTY ,T.ITEM_CODE ,T.ITEM_NM ,T.XPORT_SE ,T.INV_NO FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T.HS_CODE IS NOT NULL AND T.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO = #{EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO}

SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_CODE, A.DIVISION_CODE, A.BOM_VERSION, A.PRODUCT_CODE, B.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, B.HS_CODE AS HS_CODE10, B.UNIT, A.BYPRD_OCCRRNC_AT, A.USE_YN FROM RESULT_BOM_AP A INNER JOIN ITEM_MST B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND SUBSTR(A.BOM_VERSION, 1,6) BETWEEN REPLACE(#{STDR_MT}, '-','') AND REPLACE(#{EDDR_MT}, '-','')
AND A.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND A.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND A.PRODUCT_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.PRODUCT_CODE LIKE '%'|| #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
ORDER BY A.PRODUCT_CODE, A.BOM_VERSION DESC

SELECT A.ITEM_CODE ,I.ITEM_NAME ,I.ASSETS_TYPE ,NVL(A.HS_CODE10, I.HS_CODE) AS HS_CODE10 ,A.INPUT_QTY ,A.INPUT_BASS_UNIT ,A.BYPRD_OCCRRNC_AT ,TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE, 'RRRRMMDD') AS CREATE_DATE FROM RESULT_BOM_AP A LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_MST I ON A.COMPANY_CODE = I.COMPANY_CODE AND A.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND A.PRODUCT_CODE = #{PRODUCT_CODE} AND A.BOM_VERSION = #{BOM_VERSION}
SELECT APPLY_YEAR||' 년도' AS NAME , APPLY_YEAR AS CODE FROM SHORTEN_HSCODE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} GROUP BY APPLY_YEAR ORDER BY APPLY_YEAR DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN SUM(A.QY) = SUM(A.REMNDR_QY) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CHECK_VALUE FROM INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.EFECT_BGNDE LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','')||'%'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN SUM(A.ITEM_QTY) = SUM(A.ABLE_ITEM_QTY) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CHECK_VALUE FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.DSPTH_DATE LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','')||'%'
mapper.update: UPDATE EXCEL_UPLOAD_TEMP X SET X.ERROR_YN = 'Y' ,X.ERROR_MESSAGE = '중복된 데이터' WHERE (X.ATTR00, X.ATTR31, X.ATTR49) IN ( SELECT A.ATTR00, A.ATTR31, A.ATTR49 FROM (SELECT A.ATTR00, A.ATTR31, A.ATTR49, COUNT(1) AS CTN FROM EXCEL_UPLOAD_TEMP A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} GROUP BY A.ATTR00, A.ATTR31, A.ATTR49 ) A WHERE A.CTN > 1 ) AND X.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND X.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND X.ATTR01 LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','') || '%'

UPDATE EXCEL_UPLOAD_TEMP X SET X.ERROR_YN = 'Y' ,X.ERROR_MESSAGE = '중복된 데이터' WHERE (X.ATTR01, X.ATTR02, X.ATTR03) IN ( SELECT A.ATTR01, A.ATTR02, A.ATTR03 FROM (SELECT A.ATTR01, A.ATTR02, A.ATTR03, COUNT(1) AS CTN FROM EXCEL_UPLOAD_TEMP A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} GROUP BY A.ATTR01, A.ATTR02, A.ATTR03 ) A WHERE A.CTN > 1 ) AND X.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND X.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND X.ATTR29 LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','') || '%'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_HDER A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.ACPT_DATE LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','')||'%'
DELETE FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.ACPT_DATE LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','')||'%'
DELETE FROM INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND A.EFECT_BGNDE LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','')||'%'

MASTER_BL_SEQ_NO,HOUSE_BL_SEQ_NO,INCME_DATE,TYPCOLE,CSTBRKR,APLCNT_MTLTY,IMPR_MTLTY,IMPR_CMMRC_REGIST_NO,IMPR_SE,TAXPYER_ECTMRK, SUPLER_MTLTY_2,OVSEA_SUPLER_NATION_CODE,OVSEA_SUPLER_SMBOL,ENTRPAN,INCME_STTEMNT_SE,INCME_DELNG_SE,INCME_TYPE,CERTORG_ENNC,PC_DCLRT_ENNC, INCME_PLACE_SMBOL,SHED_PLACE,DELY_CND,SETLE_AMOUNT_CRNCY,SETLE_AMOUNT,SETLE_MTH,CVODV_USD,AMOUNT_CRNCY_USD,CVODV_KRW,AMOUNT_CRNCY_KRW,EHGT, CYCHG,IRNCF,ADDI_AMOUNT,DDC_AMOUNT,CSTMS,SLX,TRANTAX,LQTX_AMOUNT,ECX_AMOUNT,AGSPT,VAT,STTEMNT_DELAY_ADTX,TOT_TAXAMT,PAY_NTIC_NO,VAT_TAXT_STDTAX, VAT_TAXXPT_STDTAX,CUSOFCR_NM,CUSOFCR_CODE,RCEPT_DATE,RCEPT_TM,ACPT_DATE,TOT_LNE_CO,BL_MANAGE_NO,VAT_PROCESS_AT,PAY_MTD,EDI_RECPTN_STATUS, FEE,FEE_CRNCY,RYALTY,RYALTY_CRNCY,XPORT_STTEMNT_NO,STTS_AT,ENTR_FEE,ENTR_FEE_CRNCY,ITEM_DOC_NO,ITEM_DOC_YEAR,SMTM_CREAT,LC_NO,VENDOR_CODE) SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_CODE AS COMPANY_CODE ,A.COMPANY_CODE AS DIVISION_CODE ,ATTR00 AS IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO ,ATTR14 AS STTEMNT_SE ,ATTR00 AS IMPDEC_NO ,ATTR01 AS STTEMNT_DATE ,ATTR02 AS CSMHSE_CODE ,ATTR03 AS CSMHSE_KWA ,NULL AS ETRPT_DATE ,NULL AS HOUSE_BL_NO ,NULL AS CMST -- 적하목록 관리번호(MRN 번호) ,NULL AS MASTER_BL_SEQ_NO -- MSN(MASTER B/L SEQUENTIAL --) ,NULL AS HOUSE_BL_SEQ_NO -- HSN(HOUSE B/L SEQUENTIAL --) ,NULL AS INCME_DATE -- 반입일 ,NULL AS --징수형태 ,NULL AS CSTBRKR --(5) 관세사 코드 ,ATTR03 AS APLCNT_MTLT --(200) 신고자 상호 ,ATTR03 AS IMPR_MTLT --(200) 수입자 상호 ,NULL AS IMPR_CMMRC_REGIST_NO --(10) 수입자 무역업등록번호 ,'A' AS IMPR_SE --(1) 수입자 구분 ,C.ECTMRK AS TAXPER_ECTMRK --(25) 납세자 통관고유부호 ,ATTR09 AS TAXPER_BIZRNO --(13) 납세자 사업자번호 ,ATTR07 AS TAXPER_MTLT --(200) 납세자상호 ,C.ADRES AS TAXPER_ADRES_1 --(200) 납세자 주소1 ,NULL AS TAXPER_ADRES_2 --(200) 납세자 주소2 ,ATTR08 AS TAXPER_RPRSNTV_NM --(200) 납세자 대표자명 ,NULL AS CMMRC_AGENC_MTLT --(200) 무역대리점 상호 ,NULL AS CMMRC_AGENC_SMBOL --(7) 무역대리점 부호 ,ATTR10 AS SUPLER_MTLT_1 --(200) 공급자상호1 ,ATTR10 AS SUPLER_MTLT_2 --(200) 공급자상호2 ,ATTR12 AS OVSEA_SUPLER_NATION_CODE --(3) 해외공급자 국적 ,ATTR11 AS OVSEA_SUPLER_SMBOL --(20) 해외공급자 부호 ,NULL AS ENTRPAN --(1) 통관계획 ,ATTR13 AS INCME_STTEMNT_SE --(1) 수입신고구분 ,ATTR14 AS INCME_DELNG_SE --(2) 수입거래구분(IMP_DLNG_TPCD) ,ATTR15 AS INCME_TPE --(2) 수입종류구분(IMP_KCD) ,NULL AS CERTORG_ENNC --(1) 원산지증명서 유무 ,NULL AS PC_DCLRT_ENNC --(1) 가격신고서 유무 ,ATTR16 AS TOT_WT --(15,3) 총중량 ,ATTR40 AS WT_UNIT --(3) 중량단위 ,ATTR17 AS TOT_FRMLC_REPR --(6) 총포장갯수 ,ATTR18 AS FRMLC_TPE --(2) 포장 종류 ,NULL AS ARVL_PRT --(5) 도착항 ,NULL AS TRNSPRT_MN --(2) 운송수단 ,NULL AS TRNSPRT_CNTNR --(3) 운송용기 ,ATTR19 AS XPORT_NATION_CODE --(3) 적출국 ,NULL AS SHIP_NM --(35) 선기명 ,NULL AS SHIP_NLT --(3) 선기국적 ,ATTR04 AS MASTER_BL_NO --(20) B/L 번호(MASTER) ,NULL AS TRANSPRT_INSTT --(4) 운수기관부호 ,NULL AS INCME_PLACE_SMBOL --(8) 검사/반입장소 부호 ,NULL AS SHED_PLACE --(10) 장치장장소 ,ATTR21 AS DEL_CND --(3) 인도 조건(파트 1) ,ATTR22 AS SETLE_AMOUNT_CRNC --(5) 결제금액 통화 ,ATTR27 AS SETLE_AMOUNT --(17,2) 결제금액 ,ATTR26 AS SETLE_MTH --(2) 결제방법 ,ATTR38 AS CVODV_USD --(17,2) 과세가격(USD) ,NULL AS AMOUNT_CRNC_USD --(5) 금액통화(USD) ,ATTR38 AS CVODV_KRW --(17,2) 과세가격(KRW) ,NULL AS AMOUNT_CRNC_KRW --(5) 금액통화(KRW) ,ATTR23 AS EHGT --(9,5) 환율 ,NULL AS CCHG --(17,2) 운임 ,NULL AS IRNCF --(17,2) 보험료 ,NULL AS ADDI_AMOUNT --(17,2) 가산금액 ,NULL AS DDC_AMOUNT --(17,2) 공제금액 ,ATTR47 AS CSTMS --(17,2) 관세 ,NULL AS SLX --(17,2) 개별소비세 ,NULL AS INSERT INTO INCME_LOCAL_BNT_SM SELECT DISTINCT A.COMPANY_CODE ,A.DIVISION_CODE ,A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO ,B.LNE_NO ,B.POUCH_NO ,A.ACPT_DATE ,TRIM(B.ITEM_CODE) ,B.HS_CODE ,SUBSTR(A.ACPT_DATE, 1,6) ,A.ACPT_DATE ,NULL ,CASE /* 1드럼(DR) = 30KG/1 LB = 0.453592 KG/1MT = 1000KG/1M =100CM/1GR = 0.064799 G*/ WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN B.QY * 1000 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN B.QY * 0.453592 * 1000 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN B.QY * 1000 * 30 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN B.QY * 0.064799 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN B.QY * 1000 * 1000 ELSE B.QY END AS QY ,CASE WHEN B.BASS_UNIT IN ('KG','LB','DR','GR','MT') THEN 'G' ELSE B.BASS_UNIT END AS BASS_UNIT ,B.INCME_TARRATE ,B.CSTMS ,B.CSTMS/(CASE WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN B.QY * 1000 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN B.QY * 0.453592 * 1000 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN B.QY * 1000 * 30 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN B.QY * 0.064799 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN B.QY * 1000 * 1000 ELSE B.QY END) AS CSTMS_AMOUNT ,1 AS CSTMS_AMOUNT_UNIT ,'KRW' AS AMOUNT_CRNCY ,0 AS DLIVY_QY ,CASE WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'KG' THEN B.QY * 1000 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'LB' THEN B.QY * 0.453592 * 1000 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'DR' THEN B.QY * 1000 * 30 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'GR' THEN B.QY * 0.064799 WHEN B.BASS_UNIT = 'MT' THEN B.QY * 1000 * 1000 ELSE B.QY END AS REMNDR_QY -- 최초에는 원래 수량 ,'00' AS RAWMTRL_SE ,NULL AS BKRECKN_MT ,'Y' AS DCSN_ENNC ,NULL AS LAST_USE_YYYYMMDD ,0 AS INTTAX ,0 AS ECX_AMOUNT ,0 AS AGSPT ,0 AS TRANTAX ,0 AS LQTX_AMOUNT ,A.OVSEA_SUPLER_NATION_CODE ,A.OVSEA_SUPLER_SMBOL AS VENDOR_CODE ,B.ITEM_NM ,A.SUPLER_MTLTY_1 AS VENDOR_NAME ,B.BASS_UNIT FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_HDER A INNER JOIN IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM B ON A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.DIVISION_CODE = B.DIVISION_CODE AND A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = B.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND B.QY > 0 AND B.CSTMS > 0 AND A.ACPT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.ACPT_DATE LIKE REPLACE(#{WORK_MONTH}, '-','')||'%'
